tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho las byon rgyal po rnam thos sras mdung dmar can gyi chos skor rnams bzhugs so//

1$0000250bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho las: rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi dbang chog yid bzhin gter mdzod bzhugs so:1$0000300 ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rgyal chen rnam sras chos skyong gi: dbang chog yid bzhin nor bu 'di: brgyud 'dzin slob ma thams cad rnams: mthun rkyen 'byor pa rgyas pa'i phyir: pad+ma bdag gis legs bkod cing: rin chen sa la gter du sbas: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'di ni shin tu zab pa ste: dam tshig ldan pa'i slob ma ni: gnyis gsum las ni mi mang bya: rten 'brel gnad kyi che ba yin: gces gnad snying dang 'dra ba yi: rgyal po chen po rnam sras kyi: dbang mchog dam pa 'di nyid la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: sngon 'gro dbang rdzas gsag pa dang: dngos gzhi bsgrub cing dbang bskur bya: rjes la dam tshig gtad rgya gdams pa'o: dang po dbang gi rdzas gsag pa ni: dben zhing bkra shis byin chags su: dkyil 'khor gzhi ma mda' gang la: dri bzang dang ni sin+dhu ra: rak+ta gtsang mas chag chag gdab: dbus su 'dab bzhi mu khyud bcas: dbus dmar mu khyud mthing kha 'o: 'dab bzhi shar dkar lho ser po: nub dmar byang ljang mu khyud mthing: sgo rdzogs spyi dang mthun par bri: bsdus par byed na 'di ltar ro: dbang gdan dmar po gtsang ma'i steng: me tog dmar po'i tshom bu bkod: de steng gtor ma zur bzhi lhun sdug pa: dbus dang zur bzhi rin chen mtshan: tha ma kyu gu ril bus bskor: rgyu ni nas phye gtsang ma la: chang dang spod dang mngar gsum gyis: sbrus pa'i zan la bcos pa 'o: de la rnam sras sku yang btsugs: gzhan yang mdung dmar dang ni rgyal mtshan dang: ne 'u le dang lcags kyu dang: rgyun gtor dang ni tshe gtor dang: zas sna 'dzom zhing mang ba dang: 'brang rgyas la sogs bsham par bya: las kyi bum pa yang ni bsham: gzhan yang mchod gtor spyi dang mthun: cha tshang nyid ni bkod par bya:

sgrub thabs las ni byung ba bzhin: bsnyen sgrub thems pa'i slob dpon gyis: rang nyid gsang bdag phyag rdor bskyed: gtor ma mi dmigs gsal btab la: ri rab brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas na: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: sgrub thabs ji bzhin lta bur bskyed: bdag nyid rdo rje gtum po yi: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros: lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog nas: byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras: 'od zer lcags kyu'i tshul gyis ni: yang yang dgug cing gzhal yas nang: dam tshig pa la gnyis med bstim: las bum bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bskyed: kuṇ+ḍa lī yi sngags bzlas shing: lha nyid bdud rtsir zhu bsam bzhag: gnyis pa dbang bskur byed pa ni: thog mar slob bus khrus byas te: lag tu me tog thogs byas la: kye: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba 'dzin: rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol: bsod nams tshogs chen yongs rdzogs shing: 'gro don rlabs chen spyod pa'i phyir: nor bdag chen po'i dbang bskur zhu: zhes lan gsum zhu: slob dpon gyis gsung pa: kye ho skal ldan bdag la nyon: 'jig rten khe grags tshogs rnams dang: rang rgyud 'dod pas bcings pa yi: mi mthun phyogs la bya mi rung: tshogs gnyis rlabs chen spyod pa yi: don la gnas na dbang bskur bya: zhes lan gsum brjod: slob bus zhu ba: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: khe dang grags pa ngas mi 'dod: chos brgyad tshe 'di'i phyir ma yin: dkon mchog mchod cing ngan slong sbyin: tshogs gnyis longs spyod ldan phyir du: bdag la dbang mchog gnang bar zhu: zhes lan gsum zhu'o: slob dpon gyis gsung pa: bsod nams ldan pa rigs kyi bu: khyed kyis tshul de mi 'da' na: rnam sras dbang chog yang gsang 'di: bdag gis bstan gyis bu yis longs: zhes brjod nas: gtor ma rnam sras dngos su bskyed la: bu yi spyi gtsug tu bzhag la 'di skad do: hūm̐: bzhengs shig nor bdag rnam thos sras:

lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: sngon gyi thugs dam nyer dgongs la: gnas 'dir byon la byin chen phob: gtor ma yid bzhin rin chen gter: rnam sras sku dang gnyis su med: yid bzhin gter gyi dbang thob shog: sngon gyi thugs dam bdag bskul lo: rtag tu mchod cing gsol bas na: mi zad gter gyi dngos grub stsol: nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes shog: kye: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: skal ldan rigs kyi bu 'di la: khams gsum srid gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang: srid pa bran du 'khol ba dang: 'dod rgu'i gter la longs spyod pa'i: dbang mchog zab mo thob gyur cig: bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol: gnas par mdzad du gsol: rgyas par mdzad du gsol: grub par mdzad du gsol: brtan par mdzad du gsol lo: oṃ badz+ra bai shra ma ṇā ya kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes byas la gtor ma gnas gsum du gtug go: 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la gtor ma'i dbang bskur pas: rgyal chen rnam sras kyi sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang thob nas: phrin las rnam pa bzhi la mnga' brnyes shing: khams gsum dbang du 'gyur ba'i ded dpon chen por 'gyur ro: de nas mdung dmar rgyal mtshan g.yas su gtad: ne'u le lcags kyu g.yon du gtad la: hūm̐: dus gsum srid par dbang sgyur zhing: mdung dmar de ni dpa' ba'i rtags: 'gro ba'i rnam shes 'bigs pa'i tshul: ba dan 'bar bas yid rnams g.yos: bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur sgreng: mi nub rgyal mtshan bkra shis 'byung: thabs kyi phyag mtshan dbang bskur bas: khams gsum dbang du 'dus par shog: bai shra ma ṇā badz+ra rā ga ra ti sarba tsit+ta hrīṃ dza: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: dgos 'dod kun 'byung ne'u le'i gter: stong gsum rin chen nor la spyod: lcags kyus 'gro ba'i rnam shes 'gugs: rgyal blon 'bangs dang yul 'khor sdud: shes rab phyag mtshan dbang bskur bas:

srid pa gsum la dbang sgyur zhing: 'khor los sgyur rgyal dbang thob shog: badz+ra rat+na ma gu ta la sarba sid+dhi aṃ ku sha sid+dhi māṃ: zhes phyag mtshan gyis dbang bskur ro: de nas gri snying dang bum gtor gtad la: gsang ba'i dam rdzas bla na med: kun gyi rnam shes snying nas 'dren: thams cad myos shing sdud par byed: bla rdo rnam sras srog gi rten: lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs par byed: mi 'gyur lhun grub dbang thob shog: tsit+ta sarba nṛ tri hrīṃ tsakra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma lag tu gtad la: sgrub yig snying khar bzhag ste: hūm̐: de ring nas ni bu khyod dang: rnam sras nyid dang dbyer med par: khyed kyi bka' bzhin phrin las sgrub: bsnyen pa'i sgrub pa yun ma thung: mchod bstod skong gso nyid la 'bod: bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshul: khyed kyi phrin las bsgrub par 'gyur: gtor ma bdud rtsi slob ma'i lce la bzhag: slob ma'i kha chu gtor mar bstsal byas te: gnyis med dam tshig bsre bar bsam: de nyid shin tu gnad zab ste: slob ma snying 'dra min la gtad mi bya: khyad par dam tshig bsrung khag che: de nas 'di skad ces: hūm̐: sa brgyad rgyal po chen po dang: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod gnyis: dam tshig dbyer med gcig tu 'gyur: rtag tu mchod gtor brtson pa dang: bsgrub rdzas rten rdzas 'dzom par bya: phrin las ma lus 'grub par 'gyur: bai shra ma ṇā ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya dza: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: zhes brjod do: de nas tshe gtor spyi bor bzhag: longs spyod kyi 'brang rgyas lag tu gtad la: hūm̐: rnam sras rgyal po tshe yi gter: 'dod dgu 'byung ba nor bu'i mchog: rtag tu tshe la dbang ba'i sku: sgrub pa chen po tshe yi bdag: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par shog: rgyal chen rnam sras kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang: dpal dang 'byor pa gzi brjid rnams:

rigs kyi bu yis thob gyur cig: badz+ra ā yu puṇ+ye sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: longs spyod mi zad rin chen gter: bza' dang bca' dang btung ba dang: phrin las kun sgrub longs spyod spel: ma lus yongs su rdzogs pa yi: tshogs 'khor 'brang rgyas 'di gtad pas: longs spyod rnam sras nyid dang mnyam: mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la spyod: yid bzhin gter gyi dbang thob shog: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ma hā puṇ+ye ā yu she sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes gtad do: de nas gong gi gtor ma dngos grub tu rol: tshogs 'khor bkra shis smon lam btab: dkyil 'khor bsdu dga' ston bya: des ni rnam sras kyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i rim pa: gtad rgya dang bcas pa thob pa yin no: 'di ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ste: brgyud 'dzin snying gi bu gsum las mi mang bar bya: mang du spel na chos skyong sna sun pa'i tshul gyis: rang gi longs spyod la gnod pas bka' rgya dam par bya: 'di la skong gso'i gtor ma rgyun du gtong zhing: rang dngos grub tu rol ba dang: nor phyugs la byin na'ang rung: mi la sbyin du mi rung: g.yang kha bsdam zhing dngos grub ma zag par bya ba ni gnad kyi gdams pa'o: rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi dbang chog yid bzhin gter mdzod: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs skal ldan snying gi bu yi don: lho brag sman mdo'i brag la sbas: thugs kyi sras dang 'di 'phrad shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈ rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa'i gter ma'o// ྈ rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi las byang skong gso'i rim pa bzhugs so: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ gsang bdag phyag rdor sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: nor bdag chen po rnam sras kyi: las byang skong gso'i rim pa bstan: dang po gza' skar bzang ba'i dus: gnas khang bkra shis byin chags dang: nor mdzod yod pa'i gnas khang du:

rin chen zangs gzhong snod nang du: gtor ma rgyas par bsham pa ni: ri rab bang rim sum brtsegs steng: gtor ma zur bzhi pa la ni: rin chen 'bar ba zur bzhi bya: de la pad+ma ril bus bskor: bsdus par byed na 'di ltar te: gtor ma zur bzhi lhun chags pa: kyu gu ril bu dgu yis bskor: rgyas bsdus 'bring de gang byed kyang: mda' rgod sgro ma la dar le brgan btags: mdung dmar dang ni rgyal mtshan dang: spyan gzigs dkor cha sna tshogs bsham: rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal cing: gtor ma ri rab gling bzhir bskyed: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs ni: dpag med bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs: de nas phrin las gzhung bsrangs la: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: dang por sangs rgyas mngon gyur kyang: 'gro ba'i don du sprul skur shar: sa brgyad sems dpar bzhugs pa po: da lta chos skyong rgyal po'i tshul: shākya'i bstan pa srung mdzad pa: sems dpa' chen po gshegs su gsol: ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs kyi: lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: bdag gis gdung bas spyan 'dren na: thabs dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid can: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol: khyod kyi 'khor tshogs ma lus pa: rta bdag rgyal po 'khor dang bcas: rang rang gnas pa'i sa yul nas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: pho brang gzhal yas chen po'i dbus: rin chen khri rkang brtsegs pa'i steng: byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po ni: nor bdag chen po rnam thos sras: 'khor ni rta bdag brgyad dang bcas: rin chen 'bar ba'i khri la bzhugs: bai shra ma ṇā ya: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: pheṃ pheṃ: hrīṃ hrīṃ: dza dza: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sangs rgyas rnams kyi phrin las bdag: 'gro ba'i don dgongs sprul pa'i sku: sa brgyad sems dpa' rnam thos sras: khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: mthu stobs mnga' bdag rnam thos sras:

khyed la mchod pa 'bul ba ni: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos dang: mar me dri dang zhal zas tshogs: sil snyan rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: spyan gzigs dkor cha mthun rdzas sogs: rgyal chen rnam sras khyed la 'bul: bdag la 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol: rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas la: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: rgya phor bse phor snod nang du: chang phud rin chen dar zab bcas: sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga: sman gtor rak+ta nang mchod 'di: rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: a la la ste bzhes su gsol: ma hā pañtsa pū dza ho: hūm̐: rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas la: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mdzes pa'i lha mo bcu drug lon: phyag rgya sna tshogs gar gyis sgyur: yid 'ong mthun pa'i gsang mchod 'di: rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bo dhi tsit+ta pū dza ho: mdung dmar rgyal mtshan gri snying dang: tshogs kyi longs spyod dpag med dang: mdzes pa'i klu mo nor skyong ma: lha klu'i bu mo mdzes sdug bskor: rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bdag la nor rdzas dngos grub stsol: bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po: khyod ni dngos grub gter gyi bdag: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes: 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs: rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor yul khams rnams: thams cad bdag gis dbang sdud cing: mi nor longs spyod rgyas par mdzod: 'dod pa'i re ba bskang du gsol: zhes ni phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul: de nas mnga' gsol bya zhing bstod pa ni: hūm̐: ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs kyi: lcang lo can gyi pho brang na: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: sa brgyad sems dpar bzhugs pa ste: dbang gi phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir: pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra zhing: sku ni bzhengs pa'i cha lugs can: dbu la bse rmog phod can gsol: 'jol ber steng na bse khrab can: dar tshon sna lnga'i pho lang ni: brjid pa'i ska rags dmar pos bcings: phyag g.yas mdung dmar rgyal mtshan 'dzin:

srid gsum ma lus dbang du sdud: phyag g.yon ne'u le lcags kyu 'dzin: 'gro ba'i rnam shes dbang du sdud: gling bzhi'i byang phyogs skyong tsa na: in+d+ra nī la'i mdog dang ldan: klu dang gnod sbyin 'dul tsa na: rin chen gser gyi sku mdog can: mkha' 'gro klu mo lha mo dang: bdud mo'i ded dpon mdzad tsa na: bai ḍūr mthing gi mdog dang ldan: 'gro ba'i rnam shes dbang sdud cing: longs spyod char ltar 'bebs tsa na: sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'bar: dbang chen mthu byin bsam mi khyab: yon tan ma lus rdzogs la bstod: 'jig rten 'di na bgegs che ba: lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang: mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che: thams cad kun gyi ded dpon te: 'jig rten khams na 'gran zla med: lha chen dpal 'bar khyod la bstod: khyod ni 'gro ba'i don sprul tshe: sku gcig tu ni ma nges shing: dkar ser dmar dang mthing ga'i mdog: rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs phrin las bdag: cha lugs gcig tu ma nges pa: zhi dang khro dang zhi ma khro: khrab dang ber chen lha yi gos: dgos 'dod re skong khyod la bstod: zhon pa'i chibs pa ma nges pa: seng ge khyung chen glang chen dang: stag gzig dom dang ma he 'brug: rta mchog dred dang chu srin zhon: phyag mtshan rnam pa sna tshogs pa: bkra shis rdzas brgyad rnga yab dang: nor bu bī dza pū raḥdang: ral gri mda' gzhu gter gyi sgrom: sna tshogs mdzes pa'i phyag mtshan bsnams: yid bzhin gter bdag khyod la bstod: bdag ni gdung ba'i dam tshig can: tshul bzhin bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang: mchod cing bstod nas thugs dam bskul: sras dang btsun mo 'khor dang g.yog: rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa yis: khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdus: 'gro ba mi yi rnam shes sgul: sbyin bdag pho mo ma lus dang: g.yang can nor dang mdzes pa'i gos: bcud can zas la sogs pa rnams: bdag la dngos grub rgya chen stsol: mi snying sgul la mi 'gram chogs:

rang dbang med par thams cad sdus: 'dod pa'i re 'dod ma lus stsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: brgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub stsol: snyan grags gdul bya'i dngos grub stsol: longs spyod nor gyi dngos grub stsol: mi 'dzad zas kyi dngos grub stsol: 'jam mdzes gos kyi dngos grub stsol: rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub stsol: bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub stsol: dar zab rgyan gyi dngos grub stsol: rin chen gser g.yu'i dngos grub stsol: sra brtan go khrab dngos grub stsol: mi 'dzad gter gyi dngos grub stsol: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol: thugs dam ma g.yel rnam sras rgyal: de ltar bdag gis bskangs gsol nas: 'dod pa'i don la gsol btab mthus: gang 'dod dngos grub mi stsol na: thugs dam nyams par mi 'gyur ram: sa ma ya la dgongs nas kyang: de bas thugs dam brtser dgongs la: rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang: dbang sdud zas nor longs spyod kyi: bdag la dngos grub rgya chen stsol:

ces mchod bstod la brtson na longs spyod rgyal po nyid dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro: rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi las byang skong gso: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: blo dman mtsho rgyal gyis zhus pa'i don du bsam yas mchims phu'i ge gong du gsungs pa: yi ger bris nas sman mdo'i brag la sbas pa'o: ma 'ongs dus su pad+ma gsal gyi skye mtha' pad+ma'i ming can dang 'phrad par gyur cig: ces smon lam btab pa la brten nas bdag pad+ma gling pas lho brag sman mdo'i brag nas gdan drangs pa'o// //sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈ bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho las: rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi sgrub pa bzhugs so: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ badz+ra pā ṇi la na mo: nor bdag rnam sras kyi sgrub pa byed pa la: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum: dang po sngon 'gro rdzas bsham pa ni: rin po che'i snod kyi nang du: dkar rnam pa lnga: mngar rnam pa lnga: 'bru rnam pa lnga: bcud rnam pa lnga: rin po che rnam pa lnga: de rnams 'dzom par bsags la: rin po che'i snod du gtor ma ri rab ma dpe'u chung ltar bcos la: dkyil 'khor ling tshe dgu bkod pa'i steng du: mañdzi'i khar bzhag la: gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad 'dzom par bsags: dkyil 'khor shar sgor bdag 'dug la: rang dam tshig sems dpa' gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjer bsgoms la: de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du thugs srog hūm̐ yig sngon po gcig bsgom: de las 'od 'phros: 'phags pa mchod: sku gsung thugs bcud bsdus shing hūm̐ la thim: phar 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: hūm̐ las bh+rūm̐ 'phros gtor ma la phog: gtor ma rang byung rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas khang: rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang: rat+na'i khri chen po brtsegs pa'i steng na dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros gdan la phog: hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las:

nor bdag rnam thos sras sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas na mdung dmar bsnams shing: g.yon pa na ne'u le'i rkyal pa mjing pa nas bzung nas mchan 'og tu bcug pa: zhal bgrad cing mchu 'phyang ba: spyan gsum dmar la zlum pas gzigs pa: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba la: rin po che'i prog zhu gsol ba: sku la zangs khrab dmar po gsol ba: dar dpyang dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa: chibs su seng ge dkar mo'i steng na 'gying ba: 'khor rta bdag brgyad kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bskyed do: dngos gzhi ni: rang gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjer bskyed la: ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs na: rin chen khang bu dgu brtsegs nang: su bzhugs de ni su mi bzhugs: nor bdag chen po rnam sras bzhugs: 'khor rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rin chen brtsegs pa'i khri la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: dgos 'dod nor gyi dngos grub stsol: ā pa rat+na sa ma ya sdus sdus: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: nor bdag chen po rnam thos sras: sku mdog dmar la 'od zer 'phro: phyag g.yas zangs kyi mdung dmar bsnams: phyag g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin: dbu la rin chen prog zhu gsol: sku la zangs khrab 'od kyis mdzes: chibs su seng ge dkar mo 'chib: nor bdag chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: gling bzhi srid pa'i phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas: rin chen nor gyi dngos grub sdud byed cing: skal ldan bu yi re ba skong mdzad pa: 'khor gyi rta bdag brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: rin chen mdzod kyi gter la mnga' brnyes shing: dbul phongs rnams kyi re ba skong mdzad pa: nor bdag gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus kun: dgos 'dod char 'beb rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: rjes la thugs dam bskul ba ni:

ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs nas: nor bdag rnam sras sku byon cig: gling bzhi srid pa'i pho brang nas: 'khor rta bdag brgyad kyang sku byon cig: rin chen khang bzang dgu brtsegs nas: nor bdag gnod sbyin rnams kyang sku byon cig: khyed rnams nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing: gang 'dod bu rnams thams cad la: dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: re ba skong ba'i dus la bab: 'dod pa sgrub pa'i dus la bab: sngon byung gsang bdag bka' lung bzhin: bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: bsngo ba smon lam gyis mjug bsdu: de nas gtor ma mdzod du sbas la bzhag: gang bsam 'grub par 'gyur ro: pad+ma gling pas lho brag sman mdo nas gdan drangs pa'o// ྈ bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho las: rnam sras kyi skor shes pa dkar po'i mnan pa bzhugs so: chos skyong phyir 'brang tshar gcod pa ni: shes pa dkar po dar thod can: khyi dkar po'i steng na pus btsugs su 'dug pa thal mo sbyar ba bris la: snying khar tri'i mtha' mar 'byung po shes pa dkar po trā sa ya trā sa ya: s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya: mā ra ya phaṭa: bya ba bri: khyi dkar po sna dmar gyi thod par bcug la: la phug: nyung ma: sgog tsong: changs bu: sran ma: bra bo rnams blugs la: rang phyag rdor gyi nga rgyal brtan pos chos skyong spyan drangs la: mchod gtor 'bul: phyi 'brang shes pa dkar po yang yang bkug: rdzas de la bstim: re bas dril la lam gyi gzhi mdo'am: gad pa'i sna la sba zhing g.yam par rgya gram bris la mnan: steng du phyag na rdo rje dang mi g.yo ba'i gzungs dang: bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags gser gyis bris pa dang: de dag mang du bzlas pa'i yungs dkar: yungs nag nang du bcug pa'i tsha tsha nag po khro bor bskyed pa gsum mam: lnga'am: bdun la sogs pa bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bya: phyi mig mi blta: zhag bdun la sogs mtshams dam par bcad la bsnyen sgrub bya'o: rgyal sras pad+ma gling pas lho brag sman mdo seng ge'i gdong pa can nas gdan drangs pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ//

ྈ bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho las: rgyal chen rnam sras kyi gsang sgrub rtsa ba'i skor dngos grub kun 'byung bzhugs so: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje la: dad dang gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: sa la gnas pa'i rgyal po ni: rnam thos sras kyi gsang sgrub mchog: blo dman ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: lha lcam pad+ma gsal la gnang: yi ger bris nas gter du sbas: snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈ snying 'dra'i sgrub pa 'di nyid ni: skal ldan bu yis nyams blangs dus: dben zhing nyams dga'i gnas mchog tu: rtsi shing 'bras bu rgyas pa'i dus: yar ngo gza' skar bzang ba la: yo byad mang po 'dzom byed cing: bkra shis sa sna mang po la: maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi pa: rkyang nul legs par byas nas ni: khrag dang sin+dhu ra yis byugs: gnas dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor bri: pad 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su nṛ: ljang gu'i mig tu tsha dkar po: mtha' mar sgo rdzogs thems par bri: gri snying mtshal dang sin+dhu byug: de yi nang du srog 'khor ni: dar dmar dril la gri snying nang: phyi nas le brgan dar sna lngas: dril te dkyil 'khor de yi dbus: mañdzi 'am ni khri 'u'i steng: bse 'am zangs gzhong 'brus bkang ste: de steng gong gi rten rdzas gzhug: 'bru sna'i rgyal bshos zur bzhi pa: mar dang mtshal gyis dmar por byugs: rin chen 'bar bas mtha' bskor la: rnam sras sku bcas byang du bkod: rgyun gtor bshos bu zur gsum pa: ra dmar khrag gis byugs byas nas: dkyil 'khor byang shar mtshams su bzhag: 'bru ni rnam pa sna tshogs ni: bse phor bkang ste nub tu bzhag: chang phud a mṛta ni lho: spos dang dri chab shar du 'o: snang gsal shar lho mda' dar ni: lho nub mtshams su bkod par bya: mdung dmar rgyal mtshan byang shar ro: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yi: tshogs gtor mchod rdzas rgyas par bsham:

de ltar mthun pa'i rdzas bshams nas: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gsum po ni: rang nyid phyag rdor rta mgrin gyi: bskyed rim ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas: bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgrub: bla rdo logs nas 'byung ba bzhin: rnal 'byor lus la bcangs nas ni: ༈ dbus kyi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang: sgo dang rta babs tshang ba'i dbus: nyi zla pad+ma seng khri'i steng: gri snying bai yig dmar po las: 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa yis: stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad kyi: tshe bsod dpal 'byor yongs bsdus nas: bai yig yongs su gyur pa las: sa brgyad rgyal chen rnam sras ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: mi'u thung khro zhing 'dzum pa'i tshul: bse khrab rmog zhu dar dmar gsol: sgeg cing brjid pa'i cha lugs can: phyag g.yas mdung dmar rgyal mtshan bsnams: g.yon pas ne'u le lcags kyu 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: mdun du klu mo nor skyong ma: dmar ser gzhon tshul ldan pa'i sku: gcer bu rin chen rgyan drug mdzes: g.yas pa lcags kyu dku la brten: g.yon pas nor bu rnga yab 'dzin: de 'dra'i dmigs pa gsal bskyed nas: rnam sras thugs kar bai yig bsgom: 'od 'phros ri rab byang phyogs nas: lag pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis: ye shes dgug cing dam tshig bstim: smra bcad ting 'dzin gsal ba yis: bsnyen pa 'di la rtag tu 'bad: oṃ ma hā rā dza sa ma ya: bai shra ma ṇā ya: sarba tsit+ta rat+na hrīṃ dza: 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas pa yis: rab 'bring tha ma'i rtags rnams 'byung: 'od dang sgra dang dri bzang po: mi mang 'bras bu rin chen 'bul: btsun pa rta pa zhang blon sogs: phyag 'tshal bdag la mdun gtad nas: zas nor longs spyod 'bul ba dang: lo thog rgyas dang 'bru la spyod: rab dngos 'bring nyams tha ma yang: rmi lam dag tu gsal gyur nas: snang ba dbang sdud sngags 'di bzla: bai shra ma ṇā rā ga rat+na: hri nṛ sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ:

'gul 'gul: yeṃ yeṃ: dung dung: sdus sdus: dza dza: 'di nyid khri phrag gcig tu bzla: 'gro ba'i rnam shes dbang du sdud: khams gsum g.yo zhing 'gul bar nus: 'gro ba mi rnams smros ci dgos: zas nor longs spyod ma lus pa: khab len rdo dang lcags bzhin du: bskyed rim 'phro 'du yang yang bya: thun mtshams gtor ma rtsa sngags kyi: sham bur ma hā ba liṃ ta: khā hi btags la 'bul bar bya: thun mtshams nor bdag bskul ba ni: hūm̐: ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs na: lcang lo can gyi gnas kyi mchog: rin chen 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras: stong gsum rin chen gter gyi bdag: gling bzhi'i byang phyogs skyong tsa na: phrin las rnam bzhir mnga' brnyes shing: in+d+ra nī la'i mdog dang ldan: sa brgyad sems dpar bzhugs pa po: gnod sbyin pho mo mang po dang: klu yi ded dpon mdzad tsa na: rin chen gser gyi kha dog can: ḍā ki ma dang klu mo dang: bdud mo'i ded dpon mdzad tsa na: bai ḍūr sngon po'i sku mdog can: snang srid dbang du sdud pa dang: 'gro ba'i rnam shes 'gugs pa'i tshe: pad+ma rā ga'i mdog 'dra zhing: mi'u thung bzhengs pa'i cha lugs la: le brgan dar gyi cod pan brgyan: sku la bse khrab dmar po gsol: dbu la bse rmog rgya khrab gsol: phyag g.yas mdung dmar rgyal mtshan bsnams: srid gsum zil gyis gnon par mdzad: phyag g.yon ne'u le lcags kyu bsnams: 'gro ba'i rnam shes dbang du sdud: sku la 'od zer dmar po 'phro: srid pa gsum yang dbang du sdud: 'gro ba mi yi rnam shes 'gugs: sbyin bdag rnams kyi lag pa bsgul: g.yang can nor dang mdzes pa'i gos: bcud can zas la sogs pa yi: bdag la zas nor longs spyod kyi: dngos grub ma lus thams cad stsol: nor bdag chen po rnam thos sras: rta bdag brgyad dang bcas pa yi: thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i dus: khyod kyi sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams:

ma lus thams cad dbang sdus la: sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: de skad dus bzhir bskul bar bya: rtags thems sgrub pa tshang ba dang: gtor ma byang gi phyogs su gtong: gri snying rang dang mi 'bral bcang: mdung dmar rang gi lag cha bya: srog gi snying po rgyun du bsgrang: skabs su rgyal bshos gtor ma gtang: gtor ma la sogs rdzas sna rnams: mdung dmar can la mchod pa bya: brtson 'grus can gyi rnal 'byor gyis: sgrub pa mchog la brtson pa dang: de ltar tshul bzhin bcangs pa na: gling bzhi'i longs spyod 'gugs nus shing: 'dzam bu'i gling la smros ci dgos: 'gro ba ma lus dbang du 'gyur: mi nor zas gsum mang du 'du: 'gro ba'i rnam shes 'phral du 'gyur: lhag par bud med dbang du 'dus: mdor na yon tan dpag med cing: longs spyod kun gyi bdag po ste: rgyal chen rnam sras rang dang mtshungs: shin tu zab phyir gsang ba'i gnad: rin chen sa la gter du sbas: las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: ྈྈྈྈྈ de yi man ngag zab gnad ni: spyir ni sgrub thabs gzhung bzhin la: khyad par gnad kyi zhal gdams ni: phyag rdor la sogs yi dam lha: gang mos bsnyen pa thems pa gces: sgrub dus kha ni byang du blta: maṇ+ḍal dbus kyi gri snying de: rgyal chen rnam sras dngos su bskyed: de yang rin chen khri rkang dang: seng khri mdzes pa'i steng nyid la: 'dod dgu rin chen 'byung ba yi: sa bon yi ge trāṃ bskyed gsal: de dbus gri snying bai yig ni: dmar po 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: srid pa gsum nyid dbang du sdud: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: sa brgyad la gnas rgyal po ni: rnam mang thos pa'i nor bdag che: sku mdog dmar po sgeg pa'i gzugs: seng khri'i steng na zhabs gnyis ni: brkyang bskum rol pa'i 'dug stangs can: 'on te bzhengs pa'i cha lugs la: brjid ldan zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i tshul: spyan 'bur mche ba cung zad gtsigs:

dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: rgyal mtshan mdung dmar ne'u le dang: lcags kyu dag gis rab mtshan zhing: mdun na klu mo nor skyong ma: dmar ser rin chen rgyan spras pa: lcags kyu nor bu rnga yab 'dzin: gnyis su med par sbyor ba yi: sku dang phyag mtshan gnas gsum dang: khyad par yab kyi thugs ka yi: bai dang yum gyi sna las ni: 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i tshul: steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros pa las: 'gro ba'i rnam shes zas nor rnams: rang dbang med par dbang du sdud: de 'dra'i dmigs pa gsal bskyed cing: lag pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yis: ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs nas: ye shes sems dpa' dgug bstim bya: mchod gtor 'bul zhing thugs dam bskul: rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal zhing: ting 'dzin ldan zhing bsnyen pa 'bad: gzhung gi rtags rnams bstan gyur nas: rang nyid rnam sras rgyal por bsgom: khams gsum mi nor zas gsum ni: dbang du 'dus par yang yang bsgom: 'od ni dmar po bstim zhing zhu: 'od zer lcags kyus bsdus nas bkug: rang gi dpral pa'i dkyil du yang: chos 'byung gru gsum pa dag ni: grangs med yang yang snying khar bstim: de 'dra'i dmigs pa dang ldan pas: ma yengs yid kyi 'dzin phur gdab: rtag tu brtson 'grus ldan pa dang: rten rdzas 'khor lo la sogs pa: sla chos des chog mi bya bar: gzhung bzhin 'dzom par gyur nas ni: gang la bsam pa ma lus kun: yid bzhin nor bu dbang rgyal ltar: 'dod dgu ma lus rin chen gter: 'grub 'gyur 'di la them tshom med: ࿌ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: zab dgu bsdus nas gter du sbas: rnam sras rtsa ba'i sgrub skor 'di: phyogs kyi gter kha mang sbas kyang: khyad par gsang ba'i sgrub pa 'di: gter kha mang du sbas pa med: yang gsang snying gi gsang sgrub 'di: lho brag sman mdor sbas te bzhag: ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe: skal ldan las can rigs kyi bu:

pad+ma gsal gyi skye mtha' ste: lcags khams rta sbrul lo pa gcig: bum thang phyogs su 'khrungs par 'gyur: pad+ma'i ming can thugs kyi sras: tshig rtsub rta skad cho le smra: chos dang chos min sna tshogs 'byed: snang ba 'ur zhing 'dod blo zhig: skyes bu de dang 'phrad nas kyang: 'gro don bstan pa mtha' rgyas shog: ࿌ gsang ba'i 'khor lo logs su gsal: skal ldan gnyis gsum ma gtogs pa: mang du spel bar mi bya 'o: spel na bka' yi chad pa 'ong: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈ gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: dam rgya: gsang rgya: khyag dkar pos bka'i bya ra mdzod cig: ces gsungs nas sman mdor sbas so:

bdag pad+ma gling pas chu mo yos lo'i ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu la lho brag sman mdo nas gdan drangs pa'o// ྈ bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho las: rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi nor sgrub 'khor lo'i rim pa'o: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ rig 'dzin pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sa brgyad non pa'i rgyal po rnam sras kyi: nor sgrub gter gyi bum pa'i 'khor lo las: yid bzhin nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung 'di: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: blo dman mtsho rgyal nyid la gnang: ma 'ongs dbul phongs sel ba'i phyir: yi ger bris nas gter du sbas: de yi las rim 'di ltar ro: ༈ dang po rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi snang ba dbang sdud kyi tsakra la: mu khyud rim dgu rtsibs brgyad bskor: de'i lte ba la bai shra ma ṇā ya swā hā: che ge mo lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod dang bcas pa thams cad dbang du sdus shig: oṃ nṛ hrīṃ hrīṃ ti: bya ba bri: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā: oṃ pūr+ṇa bha dra ya swā hā: oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swā hā: oṃ ku be ra ya swā hā: oṃ saṃ pradz+nyā nā ya swā hā: oṃ gu h+ya s+thā nā ya swā hā: oṃ pañtsi kaḥya swā hā: oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa lī ya swā hā: zhes pa dang gang dbang du sdud pa'i ming rus tshe dang zas nor longs spyod la sogs pa gang 'dod bri: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la: oṃ bā su kī sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dza: oṃ ā nan+taḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dza: oṃ pad+maḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dza: oṃ ku lu kaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dza: oṃ karka ṭa koḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dza: oṃ shaṃ kha pā la sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dza: oṃ tak+ṣa kaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dza: oṃ ba ru ṇāḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dza: zhes dang gang 'dod kyi che ge mo 'di zhes bya ba dbang du sdus shig bri'o: de'i phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la: oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya nṛ sarba sgul sgul yeng yeng:
